Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface AiSummarizationPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
AiSummarizationAdapter
public interface AiSummarizationPort
Outbound port — summarize a group of articles into a NewsletterSection.

Implementations live in infrastructure/ai and wrap Spring AI's ChatClient. Unit tests inject a mock implementation so no real AI calls are made outside the ai-integration Spring profile.

  • Method Details

    • summarize

      NewsletterSection summarize(List<NewsArticle> articles, String topic, NewsletterTone tone, String sectionId)
      Summarize a set of articles covering the same topic into a single newsletter section.
      Parameters:
      articles - Source articles to summarize; must not be empty.
      topic - The topic/keyword shared by all articles; used to focus the prompt.
      tone - Desired writing tone for the generated content.
      sectionId - Identifier to assign to the returned section.
      Returns:
      A NewsletterSection with an AI-generated headline and summary.

    • summarizeWithTemplate

      NewsletterSection summarizeWithTemplate(List<NewsArticle> articles, String topic, NewsletterTone tone, String sectionId, String templateText)
      Summarize a set of articles using a caller-provided prompt template instead of the default template. Used by the prompt evaluation framework to experiment with different prompt variants.
      Parameters:
      articles - Source articles to summarize; must not be empty.
      topic - The topic/keyword shared by all articles.
      tone - Desired writing tone for the generated content.
      sectionId - Identifier to assign to the returned section.
      templateText - Custom prompt template text with placeholders.
      Returns:
      A NewsletterSection with an AI-generated headline and summary.

    • summarizeWithContext

      NewsletterSection summarizeWithContext(List<NewsArticle> articles, List<NewsArticle> contextArticles, String topic, NewsletterTone tone, String sectionId)
      Summarize fresh articles for a topic, enriched with semantically similar past articles retrieved from the vector store (retrieval-augmented generation).

      The contextArticles list is used only to provide historical perspective in the prompt — they are not treated as the primary source material and are not included in the returned section's article ID list.

      Parameters:
      articles - Fresh articles for this topic; must not be empty.
      contextArticles - Past articles retrieved via RAG; may be empty.
      topic - The topic/keyword shared by the fresh articles.
      tone - Desired writing tone for the generated content.
      sectionId - Identifier to assign to the returned section.
      Returns:
      A NewsletterSection whose headline and summary incorporate both fresh and historical context.

    • generateIntroduction

      String generateIntroduction(List<NewsletterSection> sections, NewsletterTone tone)
      Generate an introductory paragraph for the full newsletter draft.
      Parameters:
      sections - The sections already generated for this draft.
      tone - Desired writing tone.
      Returns:
      A short, engaging introduction paragraph (typically 2–3 sentences).

    • generateTopicSummary

      String generateTopicSummary(String topic, List<NewsArticle> articles)
      Generate a concise 3-sentence summary of the given articles for a topic section on the news listing page.

      Uses only article titles (not full body text) to keep token cost low. The returned string is plain text — no headline, no bullet points.

      Parameters:
      topic - the topic name these articles belong to
      articles - articles to summarize; should contain more than one entry
      Returns:
      a 3-sentence plain-text summary
